name: Corn/Soybean Price Ratio: Planting Season Seasonal Analysis
description: Analyzes the Corn/Soybean (C/S) price ratio with seasonal context heading into planting season (Mar/Apr/May). Computes the daily ZC/ZS ratio from continuous futures, a 20-day moving average, historical monthly seasonal averages across all available history, and deviation from seasonal norms. Outputs include a summary metrics table, 3-year ratio chart with MA overlay, monthly seasonal bar chart, and rolling ratio vs seasonal norm comparison.
source:
# Corn/Soybean Price Ratio — Planting Season Seasonal Analysis
# Computes ZC/ZS daily ratio, 20-day MA, historical monthly averages,
# and deviation from seasonal norms for Mar/Apr/May planting window.

# ============================================================================
# DATA: Corn (ZC) and Soybean (ZS) continuous futures
# ============================================================================

# Corn — primary asset
src_zc = market_data_source()()
cont_zc = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src_zc.o, src_zc.h, src_zc.l, src_zc.c, src_zc.v, src_zc.oi, src_zc.s)
zc_close = cont_zc.c

# Soybeans — reference data (reference_futures provides continuous front-month series)
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs_close = zs_ref.c

# ============================================================================
# CORN/SOYBEAN RATIO + 20-DAY MA
# ============================================================================

ratio = zc_close / zs_close
ratio_ma20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)

# ============================================================================
# CALENDAR MONTH EXTRACTION
# ============================================================================

bar_ts = index()()
month_num = datetime_extract(component='month')(bar_ts)

# ============================================================================
# HISTORICAL SEASONAL AVERAGES (expanding mean per month, all history)
# For each month, compute running average of ratio across all years
# ============================================================================

# Monthly boolean masks
is_m1 = month_num == 1
is_m2 = month_num == 2
is_m3 = month_num == 3
is_m4 = month_num == 4
is_m5 = month_num == 5
is_m6 = month_num == 6
is_m7 = month_num == 7
is_m8 = month_num == 8
is_m9 = month_num == 9
is_m10 = month_num == 10
is_m11 = month_num == 11
is_m12 = month_num == 12

# Cumulative sum and count per month to compute expanding average
jan_sum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m1, ratio))
jan_cnt = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m1, 1))
jan_avg = jan_sum / jan_cnt

feb_sum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m2, ratio))
feb_cnt = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m2, 1))
feb_avg = feb_sum / feb_cnt

mar_sum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m3, ratio))
mar_cnt = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m3, 1))
mar_avg = mar_sum / mar_cnt

apr_sum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m4, ratio))
apr_cnt = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m4, 1))
apr_avg = apr_sum / apr_cnt

may_sum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m5, ratio))
may_cnt = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m5, 1))
may_avg = may_sum / may_cnt

jun_sum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m6, ratio))
jun_cnt = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m6, 1))
jun_avg = jun_sum / jun_cnt

jul_sum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m7, ratio))
jul_cnt = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m7, 1))
jul_avg = jul_sum / jul_cnt

aug_sum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m8, ratio))
aug_cnt = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m8, 1))
aug_avg = aug_sum / aug_cnt

sep_sum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m9, ratio))
sep_cnt = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m9, 1))
sep_avg = sep_sum / sep_cnt

oct_sum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m10, ratio))
oct_cnt = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m10, 1))
oct_avg = oct_sum / oct_cnt

nov_sum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m11, ratio))
nov_cnt = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m11, 1))
nov_avg = nov_sum / nov_cnt

dec_sum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m12, ratio))
dec_cnt = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(where(is_m12, 1))
dec_avg = dec_sum / dec_cnt

# Forward-fill each month's expanding average to carry latest value forward
jan_seasonal = ffill(jan_avg)
feb_seasonal = ffill(feb_avg)
mar_seasonal = ffill(mar_avg)
apr_seasonal = ffill(apr_avg)
may_seasonal = ffill(may_avg)
jun_seasonal = ffill(jun_avg)
jul_seasonal = ffill(jul_avg)
aug_seasonal = ffill(aug_avg)
sep_seasonal = ffill(sep_avg)
oct_seasonal = ffill(oct_avg)
nov_seasonal = ffill(nov_avg)
dec_seasonal = ffill(dec_avg)

# ============================================================================
# SEASONAL NORM: map each bar to its calendar month's expanding average
# ============================================================================

seasonal_norm = conditional_select(
    is_m1, jan_avg,
    is_m2, feb_avg,
    is_m3, mar_avg,
    is_m4, apr_avg,
    is_m5, may_avg,
    is_m6, jun_avg,
    is_m7, jul_avg,
    is_m8, aug_avg,
    is_m9, sep_avg,
    is_m10, oct_avg,
    is_m11, nov_avg,
    dec_avg
)

# Deviation from seasonal norm (%)
seasonal_deviation = (ratio - seasonal_norm) / seasonal_norm

# ============================================================================
# 3-YEAR HIGH/LOW of ratio (~756 trading days)
# ============================================================================

ratio_3y_high = max(period=756)(ratio)
ratio_3y_low = min(period=756)(ratio)

# ============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Key Metrics
# Current ratio, 3Y high/low, seasonal avg for Mar/Apr/May, % deviation
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Corn/Soybean Ratio — Planting Season Dashboard",
        row_size=3,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=["Current Snapshot", "Planting Season Averages", "Context"],
        col_headers=["Metric 1", "Metric 2", "Metric 3"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Current Ratio", grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title="3-Year High", grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title="3-Year Low", grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title="March Avg", grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title="April Avg", grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title="May Avg", grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title="% Dev from Seasonal", grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="20d MA", grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title="Seasonal Norm (Current Month)", grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    ),
    category="Summary"
)(ratio, ratio_3y_high, ratio_3y_low, mar_seasonal, apr_seasonal, may_seasonal, seasonal_deviation, ratio_ma20, seasonal_norm)

# ============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Line Chart — 3-Year Daily Ratio with 20-Day MA Overlay
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title="Corn/Soybean Ratio (Daily) with 20-Day MA",
    category="Ratio Time Series",
    x_axis_label="Date",
    y_axis_label="C/S Ratio",
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="C/S Ratio", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="20-Day MA", color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Seasonal Norm", color=Color.Teal, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, ratio, ratio_ma20, seasonal_norm)

# ============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Bar Chart — Monthly Seasonal Average Ratio (Jan-Dec)
# Uses xy_bars with label=month and agg=Mean for full-history monthly averages
# Planting season months (Mar/Apr/May) highlighted by color
# ============================================================================

xy_bars(
    title="Monthly Seasonal Average Ratio (All History)",
    category="Seasonal Pattern",
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label="Month",
    y_axis_label="Avg C/S Ratio",
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=False,
    order=2
)(values=ratio, label=month_num)

# ============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: Line Chart — Rolling 20d Ratio vs Historical Seasonal Norm
# Shows current ratio behavior against the seasonal baseline
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title="Rolling Ratio vs Seasonal Norm",
    category="Seasonal Deviation",
    x_axis_label="Date",
    y_axis_label="C/S Ratio",
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="20-Day MA Ratio", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Seasonal Norm", color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title="")
    ]),
    order=3
)(bar_ts, ratio_ma20, seasonal_norm)
